question: when will the maiden edition of acmam be held and where
answer: From the 12th to the 14th of January 2022, at the AIMS Cameroon Research Center in Limbe.
evidence: AIMS Cameroon Research Center will organize the maiden edition of its annual scientific event named AIMS-Cameroon Mathematics and its Applications Meeting (ACMAM) from the 12 e to the 14 e of January, 2022.
